GA.Title: Grid Align
GA.NudgeKeys: Nudge grid with arrow keys; Shift moves 10 pixels
GA.Ready: No changes yet. Nothing is saved until you apply.
GA.DragHelp: Drag on the map to move the grid. Esc stops.
GA.Failed: Something went wrong, and nothing was saved. Your adjustments are still here. If it keeps happening, check the browser console.
GA.Numbers: Enter whole numbers within the field’s range.
GA.SizeRange: Cell size must be at least the scene’s supported minimum (50 px or more) and at most 10,000 px.
GA.OffsetRange: Grid shift X and Y must be between −1,000,000 and 1,000,000 px.
GA.NoBackground: This level has no scene background. Set a background in Scene Configuration first.
GA.Unsupported: This Foundry build does not expose the required grid APIs. No changes were made.
GA.NoGrid: Choose a square or hex grid in Scene Configuration first. Gridless scenes are not supported.
GA.Busy: An alignment save is already in progress.
GA.Conflict: This scene’s grid, size or background changed elsewhere. Close and reopen Grid Align to pick up the new values.
GA.NotSaved: The saved values don’t match what you applied. Reopen Grid Align to check them.
GA.GMOnly: Only a GM with permission to update this scene and level can align its grid.
GA.SceneChanged: Open a loaded scene and level, then launch Grid Align again.
GA.ShaderUnsupported: Grid Align can’t preview this grid shader, so nothing was saved. Close the tool; this Foundry version may need a Grid Align update.
GA.BoxHint: Drag across 3 map cells to set size and position.
GA.BoxHelp: Drag a box over 3×3 map cells, then release to preview.
GA.SquareOnly: The 3×3 box tool is for square grids. Hex grids still support scale, drag and nudge.
GA.FieldRange: {field} must be a whole number from {min} to {max}.
GA.DiscardBody: Your grid adjustments have not been applied.
GA.SaveFailed: Couldn’t save the alignment. Your adjustments are still here, so you can try Apply again. If it keeps failing, check the browser console.
GA.PreviewTip: Only you see the pink grid. Off shows the saved grid.
GA.ConfigNotViewed: View this scene to align its grid on the map.
GA.SolidWindowsHint: Turns off the frosted glass behind the Grid Align window. Use it if the glass is hard to read or slows your game.
GA.BoxTooSmall: Box too small. Drag across 3 cells of at least {min} px each (at least {width} px wide), then try again.
GA.ConfigHint: Moves the grid, not the map image. Artwork, walls and tokens stay where they are.
